subject: AWS Marketplace landing — billing CTA, burst capacity claims, and localization review
messages:
From: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@brightalpha.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS listing setup — billing CTA + burst capacity claim questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the intro. BrightAlpha is putting together a co-sell-enabled offering and we want the marketplace page to be accurate for both procurement and dev audiences. Two quick items we need your help on before the AWS listing goes live: 

1) Billing CTA and trial onramp — we want the CTA flow to make it explicit whether customers are billed via AWS usage billing or through a private offer. The current draft says "Start free trial" but BrightAlpha legal asks for a clearer path for Private Offers/POs.

2) Burst capacity wording — our customers care about predictable throughput, but also the option to burst. Can the product page say "supports burst capacity up to X v/s sustained" or will that be flagged by marketplace review?

I've attached the BrightAlpha requirements doc and a screenshot of our preferred hero. Can you loop in the correct Redwood folks to confirm acceptable wording and any tech/AMI limitations?

Thanks —
Sarah
Partnerships, BrightAlpha

Attachments: brightalpha-requirements.pdf (spec), hero-reference.png (screenshot)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.cho@brightalpha.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing setup — billing CTA + burst capacity claim questions

Team — looping you in to align on copy & compliance checks for BrightAlpha's marketplace page. Quick notes: 

- Sarah asks whether we can make the CTA path explicit for private offers vs standard AWS billing. Karthik, can you confirm if we can surface a dual-CTA ("Start free trial via AWS" + "Request private offer") on the listing without violating AWS listing guidelines? If not, what is the recommended wording?

- Sarah also wants to mention burst capacity. We need engineering to confirm a vetted statement (e.g., "supports short-term burst to X rps, sustained throughput Y"). Vanessa, please flag any UX concerns (confusing metrics, hero density).

Deadline: BrightAlpha hopes to submit the listing by Nov 30. Let's aim for an internal signoff by Nov 29 EOD.

Thanks —
Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.cho@brightalpha.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing setup — billing CTA + burst capacity claim questions

Vivek / Vanessa / Sarah — drafted guidance below after quick pass with legal and platform ops: 

1) Billing CTA
- AWS policy: marketplace tiles should not mislead about billing channels. We can have two CTAs but must ensure the primary CTA reflects AWS consumption billing if the product will be offered that way.
- Suggested copy: Primary button: "Start free trial on AWS" (links to AWS trial flow). Secondary link: "Request private offer" (links to a short contact form / DocuSign). The secondary must be visually subordinate.
- If the BrightAlpha deal will be exclusively private-offer, the primary must be "Request private offer" not "Start free trial".

2) Burst capacity claims
- Legal guidance: avoid absolute promises. Use conditional phrasing and a verified number. E.g., "Supports short-term burst to 2x sustained throughput under capacity-dependent conditions. Contact us for SLA-backed reserved capacity."
- Ops check: our current AMI/instance configuration supports ephemeral burst to handle ~50% higher token throughput for spikes up to 120s, but sustained throughput should be quoted as the baseline for reserved instances. I've attached the ops matrix (billing-matrix-v3.csv) with numbers.

3) Localization & hero density
- For US + EU we can localize the hero subtitle and pricing footnote. Avoid listing specific $/token on hero; put banded pricing in the pricing details to prevent marketplace rejection.

I'll attach a one-page guidance doc for the marketplace copy standards.

Karthik
Sr. Product Manager, Platform

Attachments: billing-matrix-v3.csv (ops numbers), marketplace-copy-guidance.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.cho@brightalpha.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing setup — billing CTA + burst capacity claim questions

Thanks — I reviewed the draft hero and prepared notes inline. High-level suggestions: 

- Hero headline: keep it benefits-first and short. Proposed: "High-throughput LLM inference with predictable costs"
- Hero subtitle (localized): US: "Pay per usage on AWS or request a private offer for committed capacity." EU: "Request private offers for EU-hosted capacity; EU billing subject to local VAT rules."
- Burst claim (short form for hero): "Supports short-term burst for peak traffic — reserve throughput for steady-state SLAs." Add a link "See capacity & pricing details" that anchors to the pricing section.
- CTA layout: Primary: "Start free trial on AWS" (blue) — Secondary: "Request private offer" (outline). Do not show both as equal-weight CTAs.
- Imagery: replace current AMI screenshot with simplified architecture diagram (attached ami-visibility-screenshot.png) to reduce cognitive load.

I've uploaded a revised landing copy file: redwood-aws-landing-copy-v2.docx with suggested one-line changes and the hero variants. I've also flagged two phrases legal will push back on ("instant unlimited burst" and "guaranteed free trial").

Cc-ing Sarah so BrightAlpha can review the revised copy. If BrightAlpha needs a private-offer specific CTA on the hero (exclusive path), confirm and we'll swap CTAs.

Vanessa
Director, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-aws-landing-copy-v2.docx, ami-visibility-screenshot.png

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: sarah.cho@brightalpha.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 14:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing setup — billing CTA + burst capacity claim questions

Sarah — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the hero reference. Summary & next steps: 

- We can present a clear dual-path CTA as long as the primary reflects how the buyer will be billed. If BrightAlpha plans to offer via AWS consumption billing, primary CTA should be "Start free trial on AWS"; if private offers only, primary must be "Request private offer".
- For the hero we recommend the brief, non-absolute burst phrasing Vanessa suggested and anchor to the pricing/capacity section for the numerical details.
- Karthik attached ops numbers for burst vs sustained; BrightAlpha please confirm the target burst multiplier you want mentioned (we can use conditional phrasing if you're not ready to lock a number).

Can we get BrightAlpha's confirmation on: 1) billing path (AWS consumption vs private offers) and 2) whether you want a specific burst multiplier listed or just the conditional phrasing? If we get both by EOD Nov 30 we can submit the listing on Monday and include the revised assets.

I'll prepare the HubSpot deal update and link the revised doc.

Thanks —
Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
